column1: # Omarchy shell plugins for the Monochrome 43 rice, read by omarchy/setup.sh.
#   id       the plugin id from its manifest.json (= its directory name)
#   source   a git URL, or `local` for a plugin shipped in omarchy/plugins/<id>
#   commit   the full commit a third-party plugin is pinned to, `-` for local
# Pins are the commits that were security-reviewed before install. Plugins
# run unsandboxed inside omarchy-shell: change a pin only after reviewing the
# diff, and do not run `omarchy plugin update`, which moves them to HEAD.
